issue.title: Seed does not appear to be changed on rerolls in conversation mode

coreClaim: Conversation rerolls send a fresh LLM seed instead of reusing a fixed custom seed from the merged generation parameters.

reproduction.method: Request-path proof from startGeneration regeneration parameters.
reproduction.evidence: Before reroll seed normalization, a regenerate turn reused the same fixed customParameters.seed carried in merged LLM parameters.

verification.originalReproEvidence: Passed: the new regression captures a conversation regenerate stream request and proves customParameters.seed changes from 4294967295 to a fresh seed; the adjacent non-regenerate guard preserves fixed seeds.
verification.targetedEvidence: Passed after CodeRabbit follow-up: 11 tests in start-generation.test.ts.
verification.baselineEvidence: Passed after CodeRabbit follow-up: line endings, architecture, frontend typecheck, Rust check, docs, discovery, launcher safety, and unused-code check.

notes: Resolved upstream/refactor merge conflict by keeping the issue-2243 proof in the singleton tracked ledger; upstream issue-2185 proof belongs to PR #2250.

preflight.evidence: gh PR search for #2243 and reroll/seed keywords found only older adjacent reroll PRs; local branch/worktree search found no issue-2243 branch or worktree; issue assigned to @me.

dependencies.evidence: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile completed in the clean issue worktree and did not change dependency declarations.

edgeCases: Regenerate path replaces a fixed customParameters.seed and preserves sibling custom parameters.
Non-regenerate path preserves fixed customParameters.seed for users who intentionally want deterministic first-pass generations.
Claude subscription runtime metadata is still appended after seed normalization.

finalDoneGate.notes: Focused request-path proof, proof gate, Bunny local review, and pnpm check passed locally before merge; after upstream/refactor merge and CodeRabbit follow-up, focused start-generation tests, proof gate, and pnpm check passed again. PR CI, Bunny, and CodeRabbit must be rechecked after pushing the follow-up.

bunny.evidence: Bunny local review remains pass after upstream/refactor merge: product code merged cleanly, only proof ledger conflicted and was resolved to issue #2243, focused start-generation tests/proof gate/pnpm check passed.
